note: Initial startup sweeps are sequential by checkout and show time-of-run variation. Use the paired follow-up for startup comparisons. Runtime fixtures are isolated core microbenchmarks, not full input latency.

baseline.scope: Startup only. Does not measure screen drawing, completion, LSP readiness or external CLI startup.
